name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class Scholarship Scheme)
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must be admitted on merit to a premier institution notified by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs (list of 265 institutions), in an approved full-time course
Students admitted through management quota in private institutions are not eligible
Must not receive another Central or State Government scholarship for the same study, and cannot claim the Ministry's Post-Matric Scholarship for the same study

Income rules: gross income from all sources is counted; for married candidates spousal income is included; if only one parent is alive only that parent's income counts; income of earning siblings is not counted; the income limit does not apply to orphans supported by a guardian
benefit: Full admission and tuition fee and other non-refundable charges in government institutions (up to Rs 2,50,000 per year in private institutions), plus Rs 5,000 per year for books and stationery, Rs 3,000 monthly stipend, and a one-time Rs 45,000 for a computer and accessories. Continues until the course ends, subject to satisfactory academic performance.
documents: Class 12 marksheet (fresh graduate-level applicants) or graduation marksheet (fresh postgraduate-level applicants)
Bonafide certificate issued by the institution
